# Generated files — do not review

These files are generated by Weaver via `make generate-all` and must not be
hand-edited:

- `schema-snapshot/registry.yaml`
- everything under `docs/registry/`
- the generated tables inside `docs/gen-ai/*.md`

Do not review, comment on, or suggest changes to these files. Skip them
entirely. Any concern about their contents should instead be raised against
the model sources that produced them (`model/<namespace>/*.yaml`).
